purpose: Finite executable acceptance contract proposed for the overnight Personal Journal and Friends Collaboration batch

actors.A: owner/author with synthetic personal Activity, Cairn, Route, and Memory evidence
actors.C: second independently authorized friend source used to prove overlap provenance

cases.scenario: A completes synthetic Hike and Run journeys, creates Quick and full Cairns, finishes, and opens the same durable Activity from Finish and Trails.
cases.not_proven_by: A fixture deep link or rendered Detail alone

cases.scenario: Activity Detail -> explicitly linked own Cairn -> edit -> return/retrieve through Memory -> All Cairns -> same Detail.
dependencies: O58 owner-history backend for complete online history
pass_criteria: accepted edit appears in all projections
All Cairns stays reachable without map/GPS
cases.not_proven_by: Independent forced routes to Activity and Cairn screens

cases.scenario: Activity Save as Route -> draft G0 -> genuine supported geometry correction G1 -> Save -> canonical Detail -> Trails reopen -> Use Route chooser -> Hike and Run pre-start.
cases.not_proven_by: Changing only the Route name or rendering the success screen

cases.scenario: Rename/edit/save/delete actions cover success, cancel, failure, timeout, retry, response loss, and rapid duplicate taps.
pass_criteria: unknown outcome reconciles without duplicate object
cases.not_proven_by: A confirmation dialog or mocked success alone

cases.scenario: Relaunch after create/edit/delete and release late create/update/read acknowledgements for tombstoned Activity-independent Cairn/Route objects.
pass_criteria: Activity/Cairns/Routes/Memory do not cascade into one another
cases.not_proven_by: In-memory removal before relaunch

cases.scenario: Record equivalent real Activity, real passive, Cairn, simulator/test, and historical-unknown evidence and reload it.
pass_criteria: simulator/test excluded from personal and friend projections
cases.not_proven_by: An in-memory source parameter that is dropped before persistence

cases.scenario: Synthetic Raw GPS, canonical movement, Clean Path/Final, true Gap, metrics, and Memory evidence are compared through Finish and reload.
pass_criteria: display geometry does not rewrite truth
cases.not_proven_by: A visually smooth polyline

cases.scenario: Memory loads with map unavailable and location denied while personal hierarchy/context and All Cairns remain usable.
pass_criteria: All Cairns visible outside map branch
no location watcher required to read history
cases.not_proven_by: A blank Expo map shell

cases.scenario: A creates/edits personal data offline, relaunches, reconnects after server state changes, and resolves duplicate/late responses.
pass_criteria: server failure is not false empty
cases.not_proven_by: Airplane-mode rendering without relaunch/reconciliation

cases.scenario: Physical-device native Mapbox, permission, background/foreground, keyboard, safe-area, larger-text, and field behavior for the grouped personal journey.
dependencies: full Xcode/iOS Simulator or owner device
pass_criteria: real GPS evidence stays separate from simulator
cases.not_proven_by: 390x844 desktop phone-shell capture

cases.scenario: A/B/C/D cover no friendship, outgoing/incoming pending, accept, decline, cancel, remove, block, unblock, and re-friend.
cases.not_proven_by: Current happy-path request UI alone

cases.scenario: B and D call every shared Memory/Cairn/Route API without friendship, with friendship but no author grant, and while blocked.
dependencies: author grant and centralized authorization predicate
pass_criteria: normal UI and direct API enforce the same rule
cases.not_proven_by: A hidden or disabled client button

cases.scenario: A grants B and C independently; each receives only the approved prospective derived projection and scope.
pass_criteria: projection carries source and auth versions
cases.not_proven_by: A viewer-created memory_subscriptions row

cases.scenario: B views self, self plus A/C, single A, and overlapping A/C cells, then removes one display source.
pass_criteria: single friend is not flattened union
friend layer never becomes B personal Memory
cases.not_proven_by: One merged polygon with no source attribution

cases.scenario: A grants B; B is friends with D; D attempts to read A through B or a copied request token.
cases.not_proven_by: Absence of a UI navigation link

cases.scenario: Exercise current and new circle/shared endpoints with stale subscriptions, malformed IDs, owner changes, and direct requests.
pass_criteria: owner scope checked after asynchronous work
structured denial differs safely from absent data
cases.not_proven_by: New endpoint tests that omit legacy endpoints

cases.scenario: Owner revoke, viewer unsubscribe, unfriend, block, owner account delete, and re-friend are executed with existing grants/selections/cache.
pass_criteria: grant and viewer selection remain distinct
cases.not_proven_by: Removing the friend row in client memory

cases.scenario: Delay A projection/read, then revoke/block or switch B to another account before the response resolves; repeat with two out-of-order reads.
pass_criteria: late data cannot publish or persist
new account sees no previous friend data
revoked error cannot replace newer state incorrectly
cases.not_proven_by: Logout reset without a delayed in-flight response

cases.scenario: B goes offline with a last-authorized derived cache, the owner changes authorization, then B reconnects.
pass_criteria: offline copy obeys TTL and disclosure
cases.not_proven_by: Claiming immediate revocation on a disconnected device

cases.scenario: B produces real canonical evidence near an explicitly permitted A Cairn; compare map pan, planned Route, simulator, content view, raw API request, historical unknown, and offline evidence.
pass_criteria: only eligible new real evidence creates one Encounter
cases.not_proven_by: Spatial proximity in a fixture or browser map

cases.scenario: B opens permitted/not-permitted/encountered/revoked/deleted A Cairns through normal Friend Detail or Memory navigation and attempts mutation directly.
pass_criteria: A's original and B personal Memory unchanged
cases.not_proven_by: Reusing owner Detail with hidden buttons

cases.scenario: A explicitly shares a Route with B; B previews and uses it for Hike/Run while A edits/revokes/deletes the original before and after B's active reference snapshot.
pass_criteria: planned line is not recorded movement or B Memory
cases.not_proven_by: Returning geometry from /api/circle/routes

cases.scenario: Inspect and query the friend candidate with existing historical Public records present.
pass_criteria: no Public discovery UI is claimed
friend grants do not expose public/stranger rows
cases.not_proven_by: Removing Public navigation alone

cases.scenario: Friends, Friend Detail, shared Memory, non-owner Detail, and permission/failure sheets are exercised in Day/Sunset/Night with long/larger text, keyboard, safe-area, and map-unavailable states.
cases.not_proven_by: A fixed desktop phone shell as native small-screen evidence

cases.scenario: Run the complete friend authorization matrix with synthetic A/B/C/D accounts against separate real connections to a disposable MySQL/API.
pass_criteria: cleanup targets only the unique disposable environment
cases.not_proven_by: Mocked SQL or source-string assertions

cases.scenario: Exercise old-client/new-backend and new-client/old-backend compatibility for Cairn history, Route origin/delete, Memory provenance, friend grants, account, feedback, and export-visible contracts.
pass_criteria: raw friend endpoint is not a bypass
deployment order and rollback are explicit
cases.not_proven_by: Local source presence or an OTA alone

cases.scenario: Load the combined candidate on an owner device against an isolated HTTPS backend and perform at most five grouped Personal/Friends checks.
cases.not_proven_by: Web screenshots, local API tests, or candidate marker

execution_rule: Every case must finish as PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT RUN with command/evidence references. Personal and Friends verdicts remain separate; a blocked Friend case cannot be hidden by Personal passes.
physical_field_boundary: Only PJ-10, FR-10 physical-presence confirmation, and REL-02 require later device/field evidence. All independent authorization, persistence, ordering, and UI work must be completed locally first.
